name: motion-haleness
description: A modern, high-contrast dark color theme for Visual Studio Code with semantic highlighting and a readable diff experience.

editor.fontFamily.default: Google Sans Code, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
editor.fontFamily.description: Monospace font family used in the editor. Motion Haleness bundles Google Sans Code; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.

terminal.integrated.fontFamily.default: Google Sans Code, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
terminal.integrated.fontFamily.description: Monospace font family used in the integrated terminal. Motion Haleness bundles Google Sans Code; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.
